name: project-suver
description: A governed AI tool hub that removes the prompt — 16 cited-or-abstain tools across 4 platforms on one no-prompt shell, safe on sensitive data (PII/PHI sanitized before egress), with a measured 20/20 trust eval (0 hallucinations). Live demo included.

An AI tool hub that removes the prompt. Pick a tool, bring only your input, get the output — no prompt to write, nothing to configure. Every answer is cited to your source or the tool honestly says it can't, and sensitive data is sanitized before any model sees it.
Most AI tools hand you a blank chat box and hope you know how to prompt it — and hope it doesn't make something up. Suver fixes both:
features: No prompt to write. Each tool does one job. Bring a document, a spreadsheet, or a message; get exactly the
Never a confident fabrication. Every claim is grounded to a span of your source and cited — or it's withheld.
Safe on sensitive data. PII/PHI is detected and tokenized locally, before anything reaches a model, then
Trust you can measure. A labeled evaluation scores the product on the real model — 20/20: 0 hallucinations,
